description:
Sheedy & Co are delighted to offer to the rental market The Old Chip Shop this former chip shop situated in the heart of Hotwells.

Refurbished to a high standard, situated on the ground floor this 2 double bedroom apartment has modern fixture and fittings throughout. 

The property will be unfurnished, has an enclosed rear garden with rear access, with it's walking distance to the Bristol's Harbourside bars and restaurants and the hive of shops on offer within the Bristol City Centre & Cliffton this property will prove very popular with Couples new to Bristol, Professional Shares or Students alike.

The property offers well-proportioned accommodation to include an open plan lounge diner. The modern fitted kitchen comes with a dishwasher, washing machine and a built in cooker and hob, ample cupboard space, two double bedrooms and a modern fitted shower room. the property is neutrally decorated throughout with a Grey wood affect flooring giving it a very modern contemporary feel.

The garden is laid to stone chip with raised sleepers for planting. 

Email us or call to booked a viewing,
